text:
nina: Quick flag from testing on narrow devices — the project sidebar switches to icon-only at 380px but the label tooltip for the active item sometimes clips under the header when keyboard is open. Repro: Console > Projects > focus sidebar item via keyboard on Android Chrome with software keyboard visible.

paul: repro'd on a Pixel 3a emulator. Tooltip is positioned with top/left calc so when the header becomes sticky it gets hidden.

anya: hmm that explains a couple support tickets where users said they couldn't tell which project was active. We should avoid relying on absolute positioning for the tooltip on small viewports.

chris: options I see: 1) change active state to a subtle background bar + sr-only label (no tooltip), 2) move tooltip to a centered popover anchored to body, 3) always show a short label below icon on touch devices.

nina: design note: showing a 1-line label below the icon only when viewport < 400px keeps discoverability and avoids tooltips colliding with the keyboard. Figma micro-proto: https://www.figma.com/file/Ui123/console-rail-labels

paul: dev idea: use media queries + prefers-reduced-motion to animate label in from below and ensure it doesn't overlap header. Quick CSS I used in the prototype:
```
@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .sidebar.icon-only .item-label { display:block; position: absolute; left: 100%; transform: translateX(-6px) translateY(0); white-space: nowrap; }
  .header.sticky ~ .sidebar .item-label { transform: translateY(56px); }
}
```
But this is hacky and the translateY value depends on header height.

anya: i think simple & robust wins. Let's try showing the short label below the icon (centered) with a small fade in. That avoids absolute top placements and keyboard overlap. Accessibility: ensure label is visible to screen readers and tap targets remain 44px.

chris: also noticed copy on the compact label wraps "Proj\nName" on very narrow names. Suggest truncate with ellipsis and show full name in the persistent label (not tooltip) on touch.

nina: good catch. Proposal: at <=400px, render icon with inline truncated text underneath (max 10 chars + ellipsis). On focus/long-press show full name in an ARIA-described live region for assistive tech.

paul: dev checklist: - implement label-under-icon CSS for <=400px - ensure keyboard focus order unchanged - test with TalkBack/VoiceOver - add Percy snapshots at 360/375/412 widths for Projects list - add cypress e2e that opens each sidebar item via keyboard and confirms visible label.

qa-bot: Percy snapshot created: builds/8810/projects-rail-360.png 0

anya: I'll update figma and add the truncated label tokens in the design system. Nina, can you open a small PR tying the CSS + tests?

nina: yes, opening PR now. tagging @paul for review and @anya for design sign-off.

chris: last nit: make sure the active indicator has sufficient contrast when label is shown. Use tokens from design system for dark mode too.

nina: noted. Thanks team.
